punchline: "Wouldn't it be great if it did?"
thirty_sec: Lying in bed, Lucy Kalanithi asked her husband Paul, who had metastatic lung cancer, whether saying goodbye to a child would make his death more painful. He answered, "Wouldn't it be great if it did?" They decided to have a child, Cady, born on 4 July 2014.
question: Which choice are you avoiding mainly because losing it later would hurt?
key_contrast: He treated the pain of leaving as the price of something worth having.
